summary.text: On Zendikar, ancient forces begin to awaken, causing the world to wreak havoc on its inhabitants.

The story follows adventurers such as Sabra, whose party finds the dragon relic chest beneath Carnage Altar, where a terrifying creature kills most of them before Sabra delivers the killing blow, and Anowon then ambushes her and slits her throat.
Meanwhile, the goblin Gribble rides a bucking creature down a mountainside and the legend of the Skrill Tamer is born.
